<!--
  information-architecture — how a part of the product is organized so people can find their way:
  the sitemap, the navigation model, the taxonomy/labeling, and the wayfinding aids. Text-first.
  Lives at: `design/information-architecture/<scope-slug>.md`.
  Authorship: curated. SLO: 180d.
  Owner: fixed to `design`, do not substitute.
  Discipline: covers the standard IA systems — organization, labeling, navigation, search; one page
    per scope. `kind` says what the page is: a `skeleton` (the structure and shell shared across
    applications), a `part` (a reusable branch of the structure, such as a contributing library's),
    or an `application`, a complete front end, which composes the skeletons and parts it lists in
    `includes:`. Author one `application` page per front-end app, and a second page for a platform
    only where its destinations differ — cross-app boundary rules live in each page's
    Application-identity section, not one shared page.
  Columns: Sitemap / structure — Node | Label | Parent | Reached by | Route | Lands on | Also under | Shown to | Order | Group | Icon;
    Taxonomy & labeling — Label | Concept | Not to use; Decisions — Decision | State | Decided;
    Open questions — Question | Owner | Resume condition.
  Cells: Sitemap / structure › Node — kebab-id; Sitemap / structure › Parent — node-ref;
    Sitemap / structure › Reached by — one-of global | local | contextual | utility;
    Sitemap / structure › Route — route; Sitemap / structure › Lands on — node-ref;
    Sitemap / structure › Also under — node-refs; Sitemap / structure › Shown to — role-names;
    Sitemap / structure › Order — order; Sitemap / structure › Group — group-id;
    Sitemap / structure › Icon — icon-name.
  Required: `## Structures considered` — a structure is chosen from two or three tried, so the
    page always records them; `None.` is not an answer there.
  Extra frontmatter: `kind` (skeleton | part | application) and `platforms` (`web` and/or `mobile`) are
    REQUIRED. `includes` (OPTIONAL) — dash-list of [[design:information-architecture/<scope>]] naming the
    `skeleton` and `part` pages this page composes; every included page's `platforms` covers this
    page's. `opens-on` — on an `application` page, the node the application opens on (a node id on this
    page, or a node on an included page as `[[design:information-architecture/<scope>]] <node-id>`);
    absent on a `skeleton` or `part` page. `journeys` (OPTIONAL, `application` only) — dash-list of
    [[design:journeys/<slug>]] naming the journeys the application is designed for. `layout-patterns`
    (OPTIONAL) — dash-list of [[design:layout-patterns/<slug>]] naming the layout patterns the
    application follows, the shell's among them.
    `invalidates` (OPTIONAL) — dash-list of [[<domain>:<path>]] naming the live pages this decision
    makes partly stale; update each in the same change. Targets must be living pages — a record is
    superseded whole via `superseded-by` instead.
  Disposition: keep every header; "None." when empty.
  Substitute: {{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{CONFIDENCE}} {{ORIGINATION}}.
-->

## Sitemap / structure
<!-- The map of screens and sections — the organization system — as one ROW per node. Node is a
     kebab id, unique on the page; Label is the term users see and appears in Taxonomy & labeling;

     `[[design:information-architecture/<scope>]] <node-id>`); Reached by says how the node is exposed
     (global, local, contextual or utility); Route is a `/`-led path or `None.`; Lands on names the
